title: LucyFix
description: LucyFix removes arbitrary friction in modern Minecraft, restoring gameplay loops and progression to natural, intuitive systems.
body: Minecraft's vanilla progression and gameplay loops consist off too many needless chores that take away from the experience. LucyFix surgically removes the aspects that I consider tedious, intended to be enjoyed as the elegant, intuitive gameplay Minecraft has slowly moved away from into more RPG-focused systems.
